text: Team Model Routing 为 DSH Agent Teams 提供队友模型路由。在 Lead 的 Agent 范围，它注册路由生成与发现工具。Lead 可指定新队友的 provider、model 和 reasoning effort，或沿用自己的模型；插件会校验 allowlist 和模型配置，并在队友首个步骤应用路由。适合需要为不同队友分配不同模型的工作流。源码未显示额外密钥或外部服务要求。

Team Model Routing adds model routing to DSH Agent Teams. Lead scoped tools let a Lead choose a provider, model, and reasoning effort for a teammate, or inherit its route. The plugin validates and applies the choice when the teammate starts. No extra key or external service is shown in source.
我想让不同的 Agent Teams 队友用不同的模型。
能不能先查看可用模型，再指定某个模型来启动队友？
Choose a provider and model for each teammate spawned by an Agent Teams lead.
Team Model Routing 的功能「按队友选择模型」：Lead 调用路由生成工具时指定 provider、model 和 reasoning effort；插件校验后创建队友并应用路由，也可省略字段继承 Lead 设置。
Team Model Routing 的功能「发现可用模型」：Lead 可查看可选 provider、其模型及指定模型支持的 reasoning effort，结果遵循启用的 allowlist。

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Team Model Routing (`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`)：Let an Agent Teams **Lead** choose the `provider`, `model`, and
`reasoning_effort` of each teammate it spawns, validated against the Subagent
model-selection allowlist.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Why it needs a plugin：`spawn_teammate` (shipped) carries no route fields, and
`ctx.agentTeams.spawnTeammate()` forwards only a provider *name* to
`ctx.subagents.startContinuable()`, which is where `agentOptions` live.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Why it needs a plugin：A teammate is a **continuable** child: the continuation registry materializes it
through `ctx.agents.create()` and **never calls a subagent provider's
`start()`**. So wrapping a subagent provider (the obvious first idea) can never
route a teammate — the wrapper is simply never asked to start it, and the
teammate silently ends up on the inherited route.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · The seam that works：```
spawn_teammate_routed            record route by (Lead, teammate name, context)
        ↓
agentTeams.spawnTeammate(...)    shipped Team service, unchanged contract
        ↓

Two facts make this work, both verified in the installed sources:

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · The seam that works：- `agent/pre-step` is an awaited waterfall that runs **before** `step()` →
  `prepareRequest()` (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:902-925 → 978 → 1050`).
- `prepareRequest()` reads `this.options` on **every** step
  (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1168-1173`), and the loop and the Agent object
  share one `options` reference (`:774`, `:1739`).

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · The seam that works：The order matters in the other direction too: the child's initial prompt is
submitted *after* creation and the loop appends it to the transcript only
*inside* that first step, so the teammate name must be read from the step's
claimed messages (`payload.messages`), with the transcript as a fallback for a
resumed teammate. Reading the session snapshot at `agent/created` time finds
nothing — that was the first implementation's fatal flaw.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Tools：| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `spawn_teammate_routed` | Same contract as `spawn_teammate`, plus `provider` / `model` / `reasoning_effort`. Omit all three to inherit the Lead route. |
| `list_teammate_models` | Lists selectable providers, then selectable models for one provider, then that model's reasoning efforts. |

Both are installed in the **Lead's own Agent scope** (never globally), so
teammates do not see them.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Allowlist：When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent/model-selection-settings` is
`enabled: true`, explicit routes outside `allowedModels` are rejected **before**
the teammate is created. Pure inheritance is never restricted. An enabled but
empty allowlist makes every route unselectable rather than failing inheritance.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Allowlist：The route is also validated through `llm.resolveCallConfig()`, so an unknown
model or an unsupported reasoning effort fails with the adapter's own message
instead of surfacing later as a failed turn.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Config：```yaml
- id: team-model-routing
  name: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing'
  config:
    toolName: spawn_teammate_routed

`freshProvider` / `forkProvider` are the provider names handed to the shipped
Team service; they must name registered subagent providers (`spawn`, `fork`).

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Known limits：- **The route is process-local.** It lives in the plugin's memory, so it applies
  while the child is created in this process. A teammate cold-resumed after a
  Harness **restart** falls back to the `agentOptions` recorded in its
  `subagent/descriptor`. Making that survive a restart needs a durable record and
  is the natural follow-up.
- **`agent.options` is a runtime object**, not part of the public `Agent`
  interface. The rewrite is the reason this stays a plugin rather than a
  one-line change; upstream, the clean fix is to let the provider contribute
  `agentOptions` through `ContinuableCreateSpec` (or to accept `agentOptions` on
  the team spawn request). The upstream repository does not accept external PRs
  — publish this as a `dsh-plugin`, and raise the API gap in Discussions.
- A recorded route that is never claimed (a spawn that failed before the child
  existed) expires after `routeTtlMs` and is harmless.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Test：```sh
node packages/team-model-routing/test/logic.test.mjs
```

18 checks over route validation, allowlist enforcement, discovery rendering, the
claim store, and teammate-name extraction. It covers `logic.js` only — the
`agent/pre-step` seam itself needs a live run.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Install：Published as [`dsh-plugin-team-model-routing`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing)
on npm, source at [Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing](https://github.com/Lingrui98/dsh-plugin-team-model-routing).

```sh
npm install dsh-plugin-team-model-routing
```

or point the plugin manager at the installed package or a workspace directory:

```js
plugin_manager({ action: 'install_bundle', target: 'dsh-plugin-team-model-routing' })
```

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Install：Installing loads the module once; because Node caches ES modules by resolved
path, **replacing this package's code requires a Harness restart** to take
effect in a running process.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Repository layout：```
index.js            Cordis Host plugin: tools, routing hook, Provider wiring
logic.js            dependency-free routing/claim logic (unit-tested)
cordis.patch.yml    Loader patch: this row + the tool-agent-team config
locale/{en,zh}.json Plugin Manager display metadata

`npm pack` ships `index.js`, `logic.js`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `icon.svg`,
`locale/*.json`, `LICENSE`, and both READMEs.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Verified live：Observed on the `desktop` profile, 2026-10-15, with the profile's
`subagentModelSelection` allowlist enabled:

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Verified live：| Check | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Route reaches the child | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'model-server', model: 'glm-5.3', reasoning_effort: 'high' })` → host log `team-model-routing: teammate "confirm-route" now runs on model-server/glm-5.3 (effort high)`, and `list_agents` reported that teammate as `model: "glm-5.3"` while the Lead was `gpt-6.1-sol` and the profile default is `bosc/deepseek-flash`. |
| `list_agents` reads the applied route | `list_agents` shows the rewritten `model` for the routed teammate, and `gpt-6.1-sol` (the inherited route) for teammates created before this plugin existed. |
| Allowlist rejects before creation | `spawn_teammate_routed({ provider: 'bosc', model: 'gpt-5.6-luna' })` → `Error: teammate LLM route "bosc/gpt-5.6-luna" is not allowed by the Subagent model-selection allowlist; allowed: model-server/glm-5.3, kimi-code/k3, bosc/gpt-5.6-sol, model-server/kimi-k3, bosc/deepseek-flash` — no teammate was created. |
| Both tools are live in the Lead scope | `Tool.listTools` lists `spawn_teammate_routed` (with `provider`/`model`/`reasoning_effort`) and `list_teammate_models`. |

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Verified live：Not covered by the live run: the `fork` context, and route survival across a
teammate cold-resume (see Known limits).

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Releasing a new version：The package is `dsh-plugin` shaped: `dsh.bundle.patch` points at
`cordis.patch.yml`, the manifest carries display `meta`, `icon.svg`, `locale/{en,zh}.json`,
and it is `type: module`. To release:

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Releasing a new version：1. Bump `version` in `package.json` (npm rejects a re-publish of an existing version).
2. `node test/logic.test.mjs` — 18 checks must pass.
3. `npm pack --dry-run` — confirm the tarball is the 10 files listed under
   [Repository layout](#repository-layout).
4. `npm publish` — the npm account has 2FA enabled, so pass `--otp=<code>` or use a
   granular token with **bypass 2FA** enabled. When a code is needed, ask for one
   interactively rather than storing it.
5. `git commit` and `git push` the release.
6. If the package name ever changes, update the `name:` line in `cordis.patch.yml`
   to match — the Loader resolves the row by that string.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Inviting the upstream fix：The `agent/pre-step` rewrite in this package is a workaround for a missing
upstream extension point: a continuable-subagent provider cannot contribute
`agentOptions`, because the provider's `start()` is never called for continuable
children. If that gap is closed, this package keeps its tools and drops the
workaround.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Inviting the upstream fix：The upstream repository does not accept external PRs, so the way to raise it is a
GitHub Discussion. Ready-to-post write-ups live in the workspace's `proposal/`
directory (they are not part of the npm tarball):

- `proposal/discussion-post.zh.md` — the post itself (Chinese, copy-paste).
- `proposal/upstream-continuable-agent-options.zh.md` — full proposal with the
  exact code paths and test points.
- `proposal/upstream-continuable-agent-options.md` — the same in English.

dsh-plugin-team-model-routing README · Inviting the upstream fix：Post it in `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` → Discussions → **Show Your Plugins!**
(to introduce this package) or **Ideas** (to raise the API gap). Note that a
Discussion there needs write permission on that repository, which an outside
contributor does not have — the prepared text is meant to be pasted by a human.
